test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some vans are autos.

Some autos are bikes.

**Conclusions:**

I. No bike is a van.

II. No auto is a van.

III. Some bikes are vans.

options.text: Either conclusions I or III follows.
Only conclusions I or III follows.
Only conclusions I or II follows.

solution:

**Conclusions :**

I. No bike is a van → False (There is no direct relation between bike and van given, so, this statement is not absolutely true. It is just a possibility).

II. No auto is a van → False (Some vans are autos which implies some vans are also autos, so, this statement is incorrect).

III. Some bikes are van
